editorial.blurb: Sang's Kitchen brings vibrant Korean flavors and creative takes on comfort food to a convenient H-Mart location, where fresh seafood and made-to-order specialties keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the mozzarella corn dogs made fresh to order—they're worth the wait, and you can choose your coating (panko, potato, sweet potato, or ramen pieces) while you shop at H-Mart.
signatureDishes: Chicken with sweet and spicy sauce
